newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank leaves German interest rates unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank leaves German interest rates unchanged.

text.p: The German central bank kept key interest rates unchanged Thursday, as had been expected by most economists.

The Bundesbank kept the discount rate at 2.50 percent and the Lombard emergency financing rate at 4.50 percent. The central bank also said it had fixed its main money market rate at 3 percent for the next two weeks.

Economists had not expected any change in credit policy at the regular weekly meeting, particularly after several Bundesbank council members said recently that they saw no need to change credit costs any time soon.
Even news that German unemployment surged to a record level in January was judged by analysts as unlikely to prompt the Bundesbank into a policy move.
